name: Disorder

features.name: Fire Frames
features.description: Split any symbol that lands inside them.

features.name: Variable bonus length
features.description: Bonus and super bonus symbols set the spin count.

review:
Disorder is a 6-reel slot with a 4-3-4-3-4-3 layout. Fire Frames appear at random and split any symbol that lands in them, and Enhancer Cells at the bottom of reels 2, 4 and 6 activate depending on how many Fire Frames land.

Infectious xWays and xBomb push the ways count higher. In the bonus, each bonus symbol adds +2 spins and each super bonus symbol +3, leading to Obsessive Compulsive Spins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 23,500x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
